rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — s12 resolves to §11's closed role vocabulary and to §4's signal-list rows, legends and functional specification, and s13 resolves to §12's table and to the pilot values §11 landed; the rationale's cited role split (alarm 42, command 80, measurement 3, state 77, setpoint 0, totalling the 202 decided) resolves verbatim to the sibling-relation section's delivery record in docs/plans/codac-uda-signals.html:237, and rigel is a partition §3, §7 and §10 already name.

rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the earlier split holds: s12 delivers the field-code table alone and s13 delivers the plant-wide assignment of §11 over the graph; neither carries the other's deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s7's dependency moved from s12 to s13 as the plant-wide run left s12; s13 declares depends-on s12 and s11, which match its own data-links, the meta declarations and the decision field-code-meanings-next, so the chain s11 → s12 → s13 → s7 is complete and no declared edge points at the wrong node.
